Messages.Author: Pheersum
Messages.Body:
Sabbat Questions---

Combat, Catatonic Fear has the superior effect Strike: Combat Ends &
the opposing minion takes 1 damage during strike resolution. How is this
possible when the V:TES rulebook pg 30 states that Combat Ends "ends
combat immediately before any damage is dealt or a strike cards effects
take place." There is no strike resolution after S:CE!

Political Action, Code of Milan Suspended states "Successful vote
means the Methuselah with the Edge burns 1 pool." This is a one shot
effect, isn't it?

Action, Slaughtering the Herd misprint. Does this really require
Dominate to play, but Potence to use?

Withdrawing from the Game. Sabbat rules update requires that if you
start your turn with less than a full hand you must withdraw. V:TES
rules don't have that as a requirement. So when I start my last turn
with a Sabbat vampire & a Camarilla vampire and a 6 card hand what, if
anything, is required of me?

Can Non-Camarilla become Primogen or not. Sabbat rules say they
can't, but prior errata said they could.

Messages.Body:

I'm sure Jon Wilkie can handle it.

Just a note - Riposte's damage is unpreventable. CataFear's damage
is preventable (although, without a damage resolution phase in which
to play damage prevention cards, you may have to rely on Flack Jackets,
etc.)

How about it, Jon?
